decision.explanation: Document d1 explicitly states Quantum Tangle won the Juno Award for Indigenous Artist or Group of the Year in 2017, while document d2 describes a fictional scenario involving a GAA GPA Hurling All Star award which contradicts the real-world context of the band being a musical trio rather than athletes.
